status: New exploratory follow-up, planned after knowledge of original results; not original preregistration
bootstrap_unit: participant; same resample across all compared features, geometries and pairings; rerank duplicates with midranks; percentile 2.5/97.5 linear; no epsilon clipping

A_pairing.arms: Original 200 A and 200 B per participant and regime; B used once; reject any overlapping A/B pair
A_pairing.cost: 4 * sum of nearest distances from A cells to B and B to A / 20; symmetric nearest-cell distance in seconds
A_pairing.tie_break: Use exact integer cost times 10^9 plus deterministic bounded hashed-edge integer <10^6; n=200 secondary total cannot override 1 primary cost unit. scipy linear_sum_assignment. Outcomes never used.
A_pairing.feasibility: Report achieved distance and fraction changed before inference. No minimum effect-based go/no-go threshold; even a narrow range is reported as limited perturbation.
A_pairing.statistics: rho by regime/pairing; F10-C delta z; paired changes versus original and far-near with common bootstrap

B_agreement.participant_summary: median across 200 draws of 100*abs(A-B), percentage points
B_agreement.cohort_summary: mean participant median; paired F10-C and descriptive F5-C; participant bootstrap
B_agreement.plots: ECDF per geometry and distribution of paired participant changes; no independent-observation Bland-Altman limits

C_normalization.aggregation: Mean selected cell alpha A and total T; R=A/T, nonalpha=T-A; never average cell ratios
C_normalization.statistics: Same-sample F10-C delta z with paired bootstrap, and differences versus relative-alpha contrast; no causal decomposition

D_pre_post.candidate_roster: Original 531 eligible pre participants; inspect corresponding session1 post EC; exclude metadata not ONLY-INITIAL-BOUNDARY, noncontinuous header, <180s, missing channels, failed time QC/schedule
D_pre_post.processing: Original 42x4s [8,176) support, linked mastoids, periodogram and time QC; no filtering/resampling
D_pre_post.schedules: Original pre schedules; new independent post streams by dataset label ds005385-post-followup-2026-11-01, original C/F5/F10 constructions and 200 draws
D_pre_post.comparison: Common pre/post eligible participants; within-pre and within-post A/B rank statistics, then pre-A vs post-A across participants by each draw (B/B secondary check); same-draw index is independent across recordings
D_pre_post.inference: 5000 participant bootstrap shared across within/cross-record comparisons; F10-C and descriptive F5; no pure test-retest/fatigue-causal interpretation
D_pre_post.boundary_sensitivity: Also common sample excluding the five pre boundary-flagged participants from existing sensitivity record and post records whose boundary annotations occur beyond initial event; report when applicable
D_pre_post.implementation_notes: The candidate_roster field retains the initial plan wording. The executed screen matched the original implemented pre-recording screen: boundary-only event types were allowed, without restrictions on event counts or onsets. The main comparison therefore includes records with additional boundary annotations. The sensitivity excluded the union of the five previously flagged pre records and post records with event_count > 1, irrespective of annotation timing. The manuscript reports this implemented procedure explicitly.
